title: AMA: Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration
abstract: arXiv:2601.20352v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has necessitated robust memory systems to support cohesive long-term interaction and complex reasoning. Benefiting from the strong capabilities of LLMs, recent research focus has shifted from simple context extension to the development of dedicated agentic memory systems. However, existing approaches typically rely on rigid retrieval granularity, accumulation-heavy maintenance strategies, and coarse-grained update mechanisms. These design choices create a persistent mismatch between stored information and task-specific reasoning demands, while leading to the unchecked accumulation of logical inconsistencies over time. To address these challenges, we propose Adaptive Memory via Multi-Agent Collaboration (AMA), a novel framework that leverages coordinated agents to manage memory across multiple granularities. translated_title: AMA：基于多智能体协作的自适应记忆
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体的快速发展，使得构建强大的记忆系统成为支持连贯长期交互和复杂推理的必要条件。得益于大语言模型的强大能力，近期的研究焦点已从简单的上下文扩展转向开发专用的智能体记忆系统。然而，现有方法通常依赖于僵化的检索粒度、以累积为主的维护策略以及粗粒度的更新机制。这些设计选择导致存储信息与特定任务推理需求之间持续存在不匹配，同时使逻辑不一致性随时间不受控制地累积。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了基于多智能体协作的自适应记忆（AMA），这是一个利用协作智能体在多个粒度上管理记忆的新型框架。AMA采用分层记忆设计，动态对齐检索……
tldr: 提出AMA框架，利用多个协作智能体在多粒度上管理分层自适应记忆，解决了现有LLM智能体记忆系统中检索粒度僵化、维护过度累积和更新粗粒度导致的信息与推理需求不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: AMA is a novel framework that leverages coordinated multi-agent collaboration to manage hierarchical memory across multiple granularities, resolving the mismatch between stored information and task-specific reasoning demands in existing LLM agent memory systems.
